refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [S, w] = peig(x, p) [S, w] = peig(x, p, w) [S, w] = peig(x, p, nfft) [S, w] = peig(x, p, nfft, fs) [S, w] = peig(x, p, f, fs) [S, f] = peig(..., 'corr') [S, f] = peig(x, p, nfft, fs, nwin, noverlap) [...] = peig(..., freqrange) [..., v, e] = peig(...)

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `peig` function computes the pseudospectrum of a signal using the eigenvector method. It supports various input configurations, including signal subspace dimension, FFT length, sampling rate, and frequency range.
